Done — `claude-code`, `codex`, and `gemini` are all connected in this repo. To do it manually next time:

```bash
entire agent add codex
entire agent add gemini
```

One caveat: there's no dedicated "antigravity" integration in this version of `entire` — only `gemini` (the Gemini CLI) is listed. If Antigravity uses a different local CLI/config than `gemini`, its hooks won't be wired up by this; let me know if you want me to check what agent name it'd need.
